pastoralcraft.configuration.title: PastoralCraft Configs
pastoralcraft.configuration.general.tool: Core growth, season and catch-up settings.
pastoralcraft.configuration.stem.tooltip: Global defaults for melon/pumpkin stem fruiting. Individual stems can override these in their crop section.
pastoralcraft.configuration.debug.toolti: Modular debug switches. Module switches additionally require 'Logging' to be enabled.
pastoralcraft.configuration.crops.toolti: Unified per-crop management, grouped by owning mod. Each crop has a dedicated section with only its mechanism-relevant fields.
pastoralcraft.configuration.general.days: Default number of solar days required for each crop growth stage. Lower values = faster growth. Set to 0 to disable the growth delay.
pastoralcraft.configuration.general.unsu: Global default (0.20): chance (0.0 - 1.0) that an arable crop mutates to short grass on each growth attempt in an unsuitable season.
Global default (0.40): chance (0.0 - 1.0) that an arable crop advances one stage on each growth attempt in an unsuitable season.
pastoralcraft.configuration.general.catc: Solar days per Solar Term (节气), used to estimate elapsed suitable days during catch-up. Must match Ecliptic Seasons' LastingDaysOfEachTerm.
Per-invocation time budget (milliseconds) for a single chunk-load or periodic catch-up pass. When exceeded, remaining entries are deferred to the next cycle. Set to 0 to disable.
pastoralcraft.configuration.general.maxC: Upper bound (solar days) on the elapsed time a single catch-up simulation may span. Default 336 = 2 ES years (168 days each).
pastoralcraft.configuration.general.defa: Default suitable seasons for crops with no override and no Ecliptic Seasons tags. Comma-separated spring/summer/autumn/winter, or 'year_round'. Default: spring,autumn.
pastoralcraft.configuration.stem.daysPer: Global default (3): solar days between each fruiting cycle of a mature stem.
pastoralcraft.configuration.stem.fruitDi: Global default (north,east): comma-separated horizontal directions a mature stem may fruit toward, in deterministic check order.
pastoralcraft.configuration.stem.unsuita: Global default (0.20): chance (0.0 - 1.0) that a stem mutates to short grass on each fruiting cycle in an unsuitable season.
Global default (0.20): chance (0.0 - 1.0) that a MATURE stem produces a fruit on each fruiting cycle in an unsuitable season.
Global default (0.00): chance (0.0 - 1.0) that an IMMATURE stem grows one stage on each fruiting cycle in an unsuitable season. Default 0.00 preserves the classic behavior.
pastoralcraft.configuration.debug.loggin: Master switch for crop growth debug logging.
pastoralcraft.configuration.debug.flaxAl: Log every supplementaries:flax state change (both halves) to debug.log. Requires Logging.
pastoralcraft.configuration.debug.growth: Log crop/height-crop growth, harvest, bonemeal, and entry add/remove. Requires Logging.
pastoralcraft.configuration.debug.stem.t: Log stem fruiting, mutation, bonemeal, and harvest. Requires Logging.
pastoralcraft.configuration.debug.sideEf: Log maturity side effects (transform/companion/bonemeal fallback/double upper half). Requires Logging.
pastoralcraft.configuration.debug.catchU: Log chunk-load/periodic catch-up summaries and NBT save/load counts. Requires Logging.
pastoralcraft.configuration.debug.data.t: Scan plantedDay anomalies (negative/over-horizon) on catch-up entry. Requires Logging.
pastoralcraft.configuration.debug.perf.t: Enable timed sections and a setBlock counter to locate slow paths. Requires Logging.
pastoralcraft.configuration.debug.ring.t: Record events into an in-memory ring buffer for crash/freeze backtrace. Requires Logging.
pastoralcraft.configuration.debug.perfWa: Profiled sections exceeding this many milliseconds warn (range 1-60000).
pastoralcraft.configuration.debug.ringSi: Number of events the debug ring buffer holds (range 256-65536).
pastoralcraft.configuration.debug.dumpOn: Write the ring buffer/profiler/data-health to the logs/ directory when the server stops.
pastoralcraft.configuration.crops.custom: Fallback overrides for arbitrary crops without a dedicated section. Format: "modid:crop_id=key=value,...". Keys: daysPerStage, seasons, topBlock, transformBlock, water, doubleAge, freeze, climbBlock, climbSupport, maxClimbHeight, daysPerFruit, fruitDirections, stemMutateChance, stemFruitChance, stemGrowChance, unsuitableMutateChance, unsuitableGrowChance.

Rice and rice panicles. This crop freezes in unsuitable seasons.
pastoralcraft.configuration.crops.supple: Two-block crop. This crop freezes in unsuitable seasons.
pastoralcraft.configuration.crops.adorab: Regrows every few suitable days (spring + autumn). This crop freezes in unsuitable seasons.
pastoralcraft.configuration.crops.kaleid: Segmented water rice. This crop freezes in unsuitable seasons.
pastoralcraft.configuration.daysPerStage: Solar days required per growth stage for this crop.
pastoralcraft.configuration.seasons.tool: Override suitable seasons ('spring,autumn' or 'year_round'); empty uses the normal resolution chain.
pastoralcraft.configuration.unsuitableMu: Chance this crop mutates to short grass per unsuitable-season attempt (-1 = global default 0.20).
pastoralcraft.configuration.unsuitableGr: Chance this crop grows one stage per unsuitable-season attempt (-1 = global default 0.40).
pastoralcraft.configuration.daysPerFruit: Solar days between fruiting cycles (0 = global stem default 3).
pastoralcraft.configuration.fruitDirecti: Horizontal fruiting directions (empty = global stem default north,east).
pastoralcraft.configuration.stemMutateCh: Stem unsuitable-season mutate chance (-1 = global stem default 0.20).
pastoralcraft.configuration.stemFruitCha: Mature-stem unsuitable-season fruit chance (-1 = global stem default 0.20).
pastoralcraft.configuration.stemGrowChan: Immature-stem unsuitable-season grow chance (-1 = global stem default 0.00).
